cases.name: read-winget-url-readable
cases.note: Winget takes the source from Source.Name alone, so Source.Url has no effect. Control: read-request-plain.

cases.name: read-winget-url-empty-readable
cases.note: An empty Source.Url has no effect under Winget either. Control: read-request-plain.

cases.name: read-winget-url-not-source
cases.note: The only trusted Winget source is named 'https://example.test'; the request's source is its Source.Name 'winget', not its Source.Url, so it is not trusted (§trusted-sources). Control: read-winget-url-source-from-name.

cases.name: read-winget-url-source-from-name
cases.note: The only trusted Winget source is 'winget', the request's Source.Name; its Source.Url has no effect.

cases.name: read-scoop-url-readable
cases.note: Scoop takes the source from Source.Name alone, so Source.Url has no effect. Control: read-scoop-plain.

cases.name: read-scoop-url-not-source
cases.note: The only trusted Scoop source is the manifest URL 'https://example.test/git.json'; the request's source is its Source.Name 'main', not its Source.Url, so it is not trusted (§trusted-sources). Control: read-scoop-url-source-from-name.

cases.name: read-scoop-url-source-from-name
cases.note: The only trusted Scoop source is 'main', the request's Source.Name; its Source.Url has no effect.

cases.name: read-cargo-url-index
cases.note: Cargo accepts a Source.Url that equals https://index.crates.io once trailing '/' are removed. Control: read-cargo-plain.

cases.name: read-cargo-url-trailing-slashes
cases.note: Trailing '/' characters are removed before comparing. Control: read-cargo-url-index; contrast read-dotnet-url-trailing-slash.

cases.name: read-cargo-url-any-case
cases.note: The comparison ignores ASCII case. Control: read-cargo-url-index.

cases.name: read-cargo-url-other-host
cases.note: 'https://crates.io' is not https://index.crates.io. Control: read-cargo-url-index.

cases.name: read-cargo-url-sparse-prefix
cases.note: 'sparse+https://index.crates.io/', Cargo's own spelling of the sparse index, is not https://index.crates.io after removing trailing '/'. Control: read-cargo-url-trailing-slashes.

cases.name: read-cargo-url-path
cases.note: A path after the host is not removed. Control: read-cargo-url-index.

cases.name: read-cargo-url-empty
cases.note: An empty URL is carried and does not equal https://index.crates.io; Cargo has no exception for an empty URL. Control: read-cargo-url-index; contrast read-dotnet-url-empty.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-nuget
cases.note: Dotnet accepts https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json on an Install. Control: read-dotnet-plain.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-any-case
cases.note: The comparison ignores ASCII case. Control: read-dotnet-url-nuget.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-trailing-slash
cases.note: Unlike Bun and Cargo, Dotnet removes no trailing '/', so the URL is not equal. Control: read-dotnet-url-nuget; contrast read-cargo-url-trailing-slashes.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-other
cases.note: The NuGet v2 feed is not https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json. Control: read-dotnet-url-nuget.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-surrounding-space
cases.note: A leading space makes the URL unequal, and it is not made only of White_Space. Control: read-dotnet-url-nuget.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-empty
cases.note: An empty URL is accepted on an Install. Control: read-dotnet-plain; contrast read-cargo-url-empty.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-white-space-only
cases.note: U+0020, U+0009 and U+3000 all have White_Space, so the URL consists only of White_Space. White_Space per PropList.txt of Unicode 16.0.0: line 12 '0009..000D    ; White_Space # Cc   [5] <control-0009>..<control-000D>', line 13 '0020          ; White_Space # Zs       SPACE', line 22 '3000          ; White_Space # Zs       IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE'; U+200B is in none of the White_Space lines 12 to 22. Control: read-dotnet-url-empty.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-zero-width-space
cases.note: U+200B ZERO WIDTH SPACE lacks White_Space, so a URL of it alone is neither empty nor White_Space only. White_Space per PropList.txt of Unicode 16.0.0: line 12 '0009..000D    ; White_Space # Cc   [5] <control-0009>..<control-000D>', line 13 '0020          ; White_Space # Zs       SPACE', line 22 '3000          ; White_Space # Zs       IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE'; U+200B is in none of the White_Space lines 12 to 22. Control: read-dotnet-url-white-space-only.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-update-nuget
cases.note: The rule covers Update as well as Install. Control for read-dotnet-url-update-other.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-update-other
cases.note: Control: read-dotnet-url-update-nuget.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-uninstall-other
cases.note: Source.Url has no effect on a Dotnet Uninstall, whatever it is. Contrast: read-dotnet-url-update-other.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-uninstall-zero-width-space
cases.note: Source.Url has no effect on a Dotnet Uninstall. Contrast: read-dotnet-url-zero-width-space.

cases.name: read-powershell-url-unreadable
cases.note: PowerShell's reading accepts no Source.Url, not even its gallery's own URL. Control: read-powershell-plain.

cases.name: read-powershell7-url-unreadable
cases.note: PowerShell7's reading accepts no Source.Url. Control: read-powershell7-plain.

cases.name: read-chocolatey-url-unreadable
cases.note: Chocolatey's reading accepts no Source.Url. Control: read-chocolatey-plain.

cases.name: read-pip-url-unreadable
cases.note: Pip's reading accepts no Source.Url. Control: read-pip-plain.

cases.name: read-vcpkg-url-unreadable
cases.note: Vcpkg's reading accepts no Source.Url. Control: read-vcpkg-plain.

cases.name: read-npm-url-cargo-index-unreadable
cases.note: Npm's reading accepts no Source.Url, including one another manager accepts. Control: read-npm-plain.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-nuget-under-chocolatey
cases.note: The URL Dotnet accepts makes a Chocolatey request unreadable. Control: read-chocolatey-plain; contrast read-dotnet-url-nuget.

cases.name: read-chocolatey-url-uninstall-unreadable
cases.note: Only Dotnet ignores Source.Url on an Uninstall; Chocolatey refuses it on every operation. Control: read-chocolatey-uninstall-plain; contrast read-dotnet-url-uninstall-other.

cases.name: read-bun-url-long-s
cases.note: 'httpſ://www.npmjs.com' has U+017F in place of the 's' of 'https'. U+017F LATIN SMALL LETTER LONG S has the simple uppercase mapping U+0053 'S' (UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line 384: '017F;LATIN SMALL LETTER LONG S;Ll;0;L;<compat> 0073;;;;N;;;0053;;0053'), so it equals 's' ignoring case under §text-comparison but not ignoring ASCII case, which the URL rule uses. Control: read-bun-url-registry.

cases.name: read-cargo-url-dotless-i
cases.note: 'https://ındex.crates.io' has U+0131 in place of the 'i' of 'index'. U+0131 LATIN SMALL LETTER DOTLESS I has the simple uppercase mapping U+0049 'I' (UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line 306: '0131;LATIN SMALL LETTER DOTLESS I;Ll;0;L;;;;;N;;;0049;;0049'), so it equals 'i' ignoring case under §text-comparison but not ignoring ASCII case, which the URL rule uses. Control: read-cargo-url-index.

cases.name: read-dotnet-url-dotless-i
cases.note: 'https://api.nuget.org/v3/ındex.json' has U+0131 in place of the 'i' of 'index'. U+0131 LATIN SMALL LETTER DOTLESS I has the simple uppercase mapping U+0049 'I' (UnicodeData.txt 16.0.0 line 306: '0131;LATIN SMALL LETTER DOTLESS I;Ll;0;L;;;;;N;;;0049;;0049'), so it equals 'i' ignoring case under §text-comparison but not ignoring ASCII case, which the URL rule uses. Control: read-dotnet-url-nuget.

cases.name: read-bun-url-uninstall-registry
cases.note: The Bun URL rule covers every operation; https://www.npmjs.com is accepted on an Uninstall. Control for read-bun-url-uninstall-other-host.

cases.name: read-bun-url-uninstall-other-host
cases.note: Unlike Dotnet, Bun does not exempt an Uninstall from its URL rule, so another URL makes it unreadable. Control: read-bun-url-uninstall-registry.

cases.name: read-cargo-url-uninstall-index
cases.note: The Cargo URL rule covers every operation; https://index.crates.io is accepted on an Uninstall. Control for read-cargo-url-uninstall-other-host.

cases.name: read-cargo-url-uninstall-other-host
cases.note: Unlike Dotnet, Cargo does not exempt an Uninstall from its URL rule, so another URL makes it unreadable. Control: read-cargo-url-uninstall-index.

cases.name: read-pip-update-plain
cases.note: A readable Pip Update without a URL. Control for read-pip-url-update-unreadable.

cases.name: read-pip-url-update-unreadable
cases.note: Pip's reading accepts no Source.Url on an Update either. Control: read-pip-update-plain.

cases.name: read-chocolatey-uninstall-plain
cases.note: A readable Chocolatey Uninstall without a URL. Control for read-chocolatey-url-uninstall-unreadable.
